annotations.title: Get a website as clean Markdown

description: Reads web pages and returns their main content as clean Markdown (navigation, ads and footers removed), with title, URL, word count and headings: start from site links and follow links on the same site, or start from web search words. Useful for RAG, AI agents, documentation import and content audits. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/website-markdown on your Apify account (about $0.001 per page; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_depth.description: How many links deep to follow from a start page (0 = start pages only).

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

queries.description: Web search words; the top results are read.

name: get_website_markdown

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get a website as clean Markdown
